name: clove
description: Clove — l'anti-dating app qui renverse les règles du jeu (IRL-first, no-swipe)

scripts.vendor:firebase: for m in app auth firestore functions; do cp node_modules/firebase/firebase-$m-compat.js web/vendor/firebase/ && sed -i.bak 's#//# sourceMappingURL=.*##' web/vendor/firebase/firebase-$m-compat.js && rm web/vendor/firebase/*.bak; done
